name: 8StarLabs UI
summary: Custom shadcn/ui registry of niche React components: timeline, status monitor, transport badge, flip clock, heatmap, marquee, JSON viewer.
description: A shadcn-compatible component library meant to complement your base kit with purpose-built pieces: Timeline, Status Indicator, Status Monitor, System Banner, Transport Badge, Flip Clock, Heatmap, JSON Viewer, Marquee, Open In Chat, Partition Bar, Relative Time, Shake, Button and Video Player. Components install with the shadcn CLI into components/8starlabs-ui, are exposed through the shadcn MCP server under the @8starlabs namespace, and every docs page has a markdown mirror under /llm alongside an llms.txt for AI tooling.
contains: 15 components: Timeline, Status Indicator, Status Monitor, System Banner, Transport Badge, Flip Clock, Heatmap
also: JSON Viewer, Marquee, Open In Chat, Partition Bar, Relative Time, Shake, Button, Video Player
installs with pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add; files land in components/8starlabs-ui
shadcn MCP registry support via the @8starlabs namespace
markdown mirrors at /llm and an llms.txt for AI consumption
positions itself as niche, high-utility pieces that complement other libraries
